contents.text:
This section covers the web side. Every site is Blazor WebAssembly, so the app runs as C# in the browser. The site's host draws each page as HTML first, so search engines can read it. The agent itself runs behind the API, which holds one session per chat and streams each answer back as server-sent events.

Source: `src/docs/architecture/05-building-block-view.md`
